segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the cleanser foams and cleans adequately, though one found it not oily enough to remove makeup like a true oil cleanser and another with acne-prone oily/combo skin found it gentle and non-breakout-inducing.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin are split: several describe it as newly hydrating, non-stripping and good for dry patches, while others report it leaves their dry skin tighter, drier, or filmy.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin generally report good balance between hydrating dry areas and clearing excess oil, with effective makeup and sunscreen removal.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin (including rosacea) mostly report no burning, irritation or breakouts and improved barrier comfort, though a few note the product can act up if left too long or still feels drying.
segments.mature: Reviewers over 50 describe the cleanser as gentle, non-irritating and non-drying for aging skin, with one calling it 'lux' and suited to increasingly dry mature skin.

concerns.aging: Reviewers in their 40s-50s report the cleanser feels gentle and non-drying on mature skin, with one crediting oil cleansers generally for skin improvement after 40; no negative aging-specific comments appear.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers report it hydrates without stripping or tightness, especially valued in winter or after sun exposure; however several others explicitly report it leaves skin dehydrated, tight, or drier than expected, including one who returned it for this reason.
concerns.redness: A couple of reviewers with rosacea or general redness report it lessened redness and caused no irritation, describing it as barrier-repairing.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers credit the cleanser with repairing or protecting a compromised skin barrier and note no stinging or reactivity; one review describes an initial 'purging' phase before improvement.
concerns.spots: One reviewer noticed a reduction in small blackheads on the nose within a week of use; no other spot-specific reports appear.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers with acne-prone skin report no new breakouts or fewer pimples over time, but a notable minority report the product caused sudden, unusual breakouts including one describing severe breakouts that stopped only after discontinuing use.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin report it cleans excess oil sufficiently and foams well, though one felt it lacked the oil-cleanser feel needed to fully dissolve makeup on oily skin.

extraits.texte: i bought this because i saw that it says its an oil cleanser and its hydrating. it also looks oily in the container. background, i have oil skin. i like a japanese oil cleanser cause it removes all my makeup. regular oil cleansers look and feel oily when applied on dry skin and then once water is applied it gets milky or foamy. this cleanser doesnt even have the oil texture when you apply it on dry skin. it just gets sticky like a regular cleanser. once you add water it does foam up but once i rinse and pat dry my skin feels SO DEHYDRATED and tight. it also didnt remove all my makeup like a typical oil cleanser. literally only 1/3 of the claims is accurate which is the foaming aspect. i dont recommend. try a different oil cleanser and youll see a remarkable difference in hydration as well as its ability to remove all your makeup

extraits.titre: I wanted to like this product….
extraits.texte: I usually love cerave products- I love their lotion, the night lotion, and the hydrating face wash. I liked that this product cleansed my face and took all my makeup off, was not stripping and has no added perfume. However, this product- for whatever reason- made my skin break out SO BAD. I was getting breakouts where I never typically get them, and once I stopped using this product, my skin went back to normal. Such a bummer, because I literally love everything else about this product.

extraits.titre: Great product for my combo skin!
extraits.texte: I personally really like this cleanser, and it seems to work really well on my acne prone oily/combo skin. Some people in other reviews have complained it's not a true oil cleanser. While I do agree that it's more water based and not a full on oil, it is much more gentle on the skin than other foaming face washes because it does have some oil in it. It's almost like an oily soap? I like this because I think an actual oil cleanser would break me out. My face gets so dry in the winter to the point I am unable to use my acne wash (Panoxyl and La Roshe) as often, so I started using this and it's helped with my dryness so much and didn't cause me to breakout more. I break out very very easily too. If you have combo skin this is perfect for maintaining hydration on dry spots and getting rid of excess oil on oiler spots.

extraits.titre: Saved my skin! BEST hybrid cleanser EVER!
extraits.texte: I never write reviews but I just had to share. I've repurchased this product multiple times now. When I first started using this product my dry, sensitive, acne prone skin with rosacea was in full disarray. In my 30s and I've tried everything. I credit this product to healing my skin barrier over the past few months. I use it as a double cleanser and cleanser (wash my face twice) when wearing makeup. Once when wearing no makeup. Then right after the shower I follow up with a hydrating toner, milky toner, eye cream, and moisturizer. Day time I add sunscreen, night I use a gentle AHA serum. My partner's combo, acne prone skin has also dramatically improved as well! I would say this a great starting cleanser for any skin type. Any age. It's not an oil cleanser, but rather more like a water consistency. If you're wanting a true oil cleanser/cleansing balm, look elsewhere. That's probably why anyone would dislike this. My skin went through a "purging" phase in the beginning because my skin was so dehydrated and congested. Expect some temporary acne if you have a similar skin type. Push through and I promise it's worth it. CeraVe please never discontinue this!!

extraits.titre: Great for my dry sensitive skin!
extraits.texte: I have dry, sensitive & rosacea, prone skin. I ran out of my very expensive cleanser & wanted to try a more economical cleanser. This cleanser does a great job removing my makeup & doesn't leave my skin dried out (anymore than it already is).

I struggle with adult acne and my skin is very sensitive to strong ingredients such as benzoyl peroxide. I've been using Rodan and Fields Unblemish Cleanser but it is very expensive. I decided to try this and WOW. I finally found something that works for my skin and doesn't over dry my skin. It does a great job removing makeup. If I have a lot I wash twice and that does the trick. When I use a toner after, I can see how clean it left my face. Also I have seen an improvement with my acne, less breakouts.
This cleanser is so gentle on my mature skin. It did not leave me feeling dry or irritated. Would highly recommend for anyone. I'm 58 and have combination skin.
